text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
“—Silence Suzuka was incredible...!
She was on a completely different level compared to the Nippon Derby!”

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Her front-running was incredible, my heart was racing~……!
To think she was capable of running like that……!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ――...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I feel more confident than ever before...
In the next race... surely...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa... Haa...――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Suzuka... you...

“—Into the third corner!
Setting a blazing pace, it's Silence Suzuka!!—”

"—And they've swept past
beyond the Great Zelkova Tree!!—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Are they planning to reach it already?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Stego-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Is your next race... the Tenno Sho (Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Yes. That's true, but—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Senpai, how do you know about that...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...No, it's nothing.
Just got a little curious, is all."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Your running today was amazing.
I'm looking forward to the Tenno Sho (Autumn) too."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well, see ya—

Stay Gold returned safely after completing the
Mainichi Okan. Yet, for some reason,
she wore a solemn expression...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...It seems the time has finally come.
The true "storm" of this journey.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
How did Suzuka's running look
from your perspective today?
"An overwhelming run, beyond belief for a Classic Class Umamusume. To be honest, seeing such terrifying growth speed was truly intimidating."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, it really is too soon.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
For some reason,
she's already on the verge of reaching the aurora.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The most dazzling, powerful moment of a "shining one."
A figure burned into "memory," never to fade—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Well, just think of it as my prime, in a way.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Her reaching that point shouldn't have happened,
at least not during the Classic period.
...At least, not in my "memories."
choice_data_list: And yet, you're already on the verge of reaching it now...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...If she becomes an aurora now,
just like in those "memories"... then—

...It was a truly brief silence,
lasting not even a few seconds in actual time.

To me, however, that silence felt dreadfully long,
and it seemed as if something small was swirling within her—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I have a request.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Please, let me run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
choice_data_list: !! ...In that case, the Kikuka Sho will be—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I won't run.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...I need to compete against Suzuka in her next race
and find out for myself.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
What is happening right now
on this journey to destroy all of the past?

Stay Gold's eyes are already set.
Steadfastly focused on where she needs to go next.
In that case—
choice_data_list: Got it. Leave the readjustments to me.
Got it. Leave the readjustments to me.

text_block_list.text:
"...We must immediately switch everything we prepared for the 'Kikuka Sho' over to the 'Tenno Sho (Autumn)'.
On top of that, we need a countermeasure against Silence Suzuka."

To an outsider, it must seem like a reckless change of plans.
Yet, precisely because it's such an unpredictable journey,
I can't help but think—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit.

"...And so, turning away from the intended path of the
Kikuka Sho, the journey toward the Tenno Sho (Autumn) begins."
What lies in wait ahead—a storm of swirling black clouds barring the way? Or an aurora piercing the darkness to illuminate the path—
